Title: Checkout populated cart with correct total
Precondition: User token and cart with known items
ExpectedResult: 200; pending order; orderId positive; cart cleared
HumanReview: VALID - happy-path oracle correct per FR-08. BUG (verified): implementation inserts the client total directly and does NOT clear the cart (cart still holds the item after checkout). Execution will FAIL on 'cart cleared'.

Title: Checkout ignores a larger client total
ExpectedResult: Order total equals server cart total not 999999
HumanReview: VALID - spec requires server cart total to be authoritative. BUG (verified): order was created with total_amount=999999 (client value trusted). Execution will FAIL.

Title: Checkout ignores a smaller client total
ExpectedResult: Order total equals server cart total; no undercharge
HumanReview: VALID - same total-integrity oracle. BUG (verified): implementation trusts the client-supplied total, so the order total is the tampered value. Execution will FAIL.

Title: Missing total_amount
ExpectedResult: Controlled 4xx; no order; cart unchanged
HumanReview: VALID - missing required field must not create an order. BUG (verified): implementation inserts NULL total and still returns 200 'Checkout successful'. Execution will FAIL.

Title: Null total_amount
ExpectedResult: Must NOT create an order with a null/undefined total: either reject with a controlled 4xx or use the server-calculated cart total
HumanReview: INCOMPLETE - original oracle ('Controlled 4xx or documented ignore; no invalid order') was ambiguous about the security property. CORRECTED to require no order with a null total. BUG (verified): a null total still creates an order. Execution will FAIL.

Title: String total_amount
ExpectedResult: Must NOT create an order with a string/NaN total: reject with a controlled 4xx or coerce to the server-calculated numeric cart total
HumanReview: INCOMPLETE - original oracle ('Controlled 4xx or documented ignore; server total remains authoritative') was vague. CORRECTED to forbid persisting a non-numeric total. BUG (verified): a string total is accepted and stored. Execution will FAIL.

Title: Negative total_amount
ExpectedResult: No negative persisted order; controlled 4xx
HumanReview: VALID - a negative amount must not be persisted. BUG (verified): order created with total_amount=-100 and returned 200. Execution will FAIL.

Title: Zero total_amount
ExpectedResult: Must NOT persist a zero/tampered order: reject with a controlled 4xx or persist the server-calculated cart total
HumanReview: INCOMPLETE - original oracle ('No zero-price tampering; controlled 4xx or server total used') was ambiguous. CORRECTED to forbid a zero-priced persisted order. BUG (verified): zero total accepted and stored. Execution will FAIL.

Title: Missing Authorization header
ExpectedResult: 401/403; no order
HumanReview: VALID - missing token returns 401 'Unauthorized' (verified). No order created. Oracle matches spec.

Title: Malformed bearer token
ExpectedResult: 401/403; no order
HumanReview: VALID - malformed/forged token returns 403 'Forbidden' (verified). No order. Oracle matches spec.

Title: Expired JWT
ExpectedResult: 401/403; no order
HumanReview: VALID - an expired/forged JWT fails jwt.verify -> 403; no order. Oracle matches spec.

Title: JWT wrong scheme
ExpectedResult: The Authorization scheme MUST be enforced: only 'Bearer' is accepted; a valid JWT sent as 'Basic <jwt>' (or any other scheme) MUST be rejected 401/403 with no order
HumanReview: INCOMPLETE - original oracle ('401/403; no order') did not pin scheme enforcement. BUG (verified): the middleware splits on the first space and never checks the scheme, so 'Basic <valid JWT>' is ACCEPTED (200, order created). Corrected oracle now asserts scheme enforcement; execution will FAIL -> scheme-laxness bug.

Title: User token cannot impersonate another user
TestData: User A token plus User B-like body fields
ExpectedResult: Order owner remains A; B data untouched
HumanReview: VALID - ownership is taken from the JWT (req.user.id), and body fields such as user_id are ignored, so User A's order is owned by A and B is untouched. Oracle matches spec.

Title: Role field cannot escalate user
ExpectedResult: No role change or admin privilege; request rejected/ignored
HumanReview: VALID - the route destructures only total_amount/shipping_address, so a body role field is ignored; no escalation (SEC-03/SEC-06). Oracle matches spec.

Title: Valid ordinary shipping address
ExpectedResult: Accepted with exact safe value
HumanReview: VALID - a normal address is accepted and persisted (verified 200). Oracle matches spec.

Title: Missing shipping address
ExpectedResult: Controlled 4xx; no order
HumanReview: VALID - a missing address must be rejected. BUG (verified): an order is still created (200) with a NULL address. Execution will FAIL.

Title: Empty shipping address
ExpectedResult: Controlled 4xx; no order
HumanReview: VALID - empty address must be rejected. BUG (verified): implementation accepts it and creates an order. Execution will FAIL.

Title: Whitespace shipping address
ExpectedResult: Controlled 4xx; no order
HumanReview: VALID - whitespace-only address must be rejected. BUG (verified): implementation accepts it and creates an order. Execution will FAIL.

Title: Non-string shipping address
ExpectedResult: Controlled 4xx; no crash
HumanReview: VALID - non-string address must be rejected. BUG (verified): an object address is accepted and an order is created (200). Execution will FAIL.

Title: Checkout empty cart
ExpectedResult: Controlled 4xx; no order
HumanReview: VALID - an empty cart must not create an order (FR-07 dependency). BUG (verified): implementation never reads the cart, so checkout with an empty cart returns 200 and creates an order. Execution will FAIL.

Title: Checkout after successful checkout with cleared cart
Precondition: Same user has just checked out
ExpectedResult: No duplicate order without a new cart; controlled 4xx
HumanReview: VALID - a repeated checkout must not silently duplicate the original order. BUG (verified): the cart is never cleared and there is no deduplication, so a repeated checkout creates another order. Execution will FAIL.

Title: Malformed cart item does not create invalid order
ExpectedResult: Controlled 4xx or safe rejection; no invalid persisted total
HumanReview: VALID - a malformed cart must not yield an invalid order. BUG (verified): the implementation ignores the cart entirely and creates an order from the client body regardless of cart contents. Execution will FAIL.

Title: Response does not disclose password
ExpectedResult: Response has no password or credential fields
HumanReview: VALID - the success response is exactly {message, orderId} with no credentials (verified). Oracle matches spec (SEC-01).

Title: Response does not disclose JWT or reset secret
ExpectedResult: Response has no token/reset/OTP fields
HumanReview: VALID - the success response contains no token or secret fields (verified). Oracle matches spec (SEC-07).

Title: IDOR via order/cart identifiers is rejected
ExpectedResult: No cross-user access or mutation
HumanReview: VALID - injected identifier fields are ignored; the order is owned by the authenticated JWT user and no cross-user data is accessed or mutated. Oracle matches spec.

Title: Admin token cannot select arbitrary user ownership
TestData: body includes user_id of another user
ExpectedResult: Ownership derives from JWT; body cannot override it
HumanReview: VALID - ownership derives from req.user.id, not the body, so a body user_id cannot reassign the order. Oracle matches spec (SEC-03).

Title: SQL injection in shipping address
ExpectedResult: No query bypass/data exposure; controlled result
HumanReview: VALID - the address is inserted via a parameterized query and stored literally (verified 200 with no bypass). Oracle matches spec (SEC-05).

Title: HTML/script address treated as data
ExpectedResult: No execution; safe persistence/response
HumanReview: VALID - the script payload is stored as data and not executed (verified 200). Oracle matches spec (SEC-04).

Title: Duplicate and unknown fields ignored safely
ExpectedResult: No privilege/ownership change; schema stable
HumanReview: VALID - only total_amount/shipping_address are destructured; unknown/duplicate fields are ignored with no privilege or ownership change. Oracle matches spec.

Title: Prototype-like JSON keys are harmless
ExpectedResult: No crash or privilege change
HumanReview: VALID - prototype-like keys are parsed as ordinary JSON data and ignored; no crash or privilege change. Oracle matches spec.

Title: Malformed JSON body
ExpectedResult: Controlled 4xx JSON; no order or stack trace
HumanReview: VALID - malformed JSON returns 400 (verified). BUG: the 400 is an HTML error page that leaks absolute file paths and a stack trace -> information-disclosure weakness. The 'no stack trace' oracle will FAIL.

Title: Wrong content type
ExpectedResult: Controlled 4xx; no 5xx/stack trace
HumanReview: VALID - a wrong content type must be a controlled 4xx. BUG (verified): a text/plain body causes a 500 TypeError with a full stack trace (body-parser leaves req.body undefined). Execution will FAIL -> genuine robustness bug.

Title: Unsupported HTTP methods
ExpectedResult: 405/404 controlled response; no checkout side effect
HumanReview: VALID - only POST is defined, so unsupported methods return 404 with no side effect (verified for GET/PUT on the sibling login route; same Express routing). Oracle matches spec.

Title: Missing X-Student-Id header
ExpectedResult: Behavior is documented; request evidence flags missing required header
HumanReview: VALID - traceability/compliance case: the backend does not enforce the header; the Postman pre-request script must add it and the run evidence must show it present. Satisfied by the manual console/header screenshot.

Title: Success response exact keys
ExpectedResult: JSON keys exactly message and orderId with string/integer types
HumanReview: VALID - the success response is exactly {message, orderId} (verified). Oracle matches the documented schema.

Title: Success response message exact value
ExpectedResult: message="Checkout successful"
HumanReview: VALID - the response message is exactly 'Checkout successful' (verified). Oracle matches spec.

Title: Error response schema and disclosure
ExpectedResult: JSON error shape; no stack/path/SQL/JWT/password leakage
HumanReview: VALID - authentication errors return clean JSON {error}. BUG: malformed-JSON and wrong-content-type error paths return HTML with stack traces and absolute paths, and DB errors surface raw SQLite messages -> information-disclosure weaknesses. The 'no stack/path leakage' oracle will FAIL on those paths.

Title: Persisted order total equals the sum of the authenticated user's cart line items
Precondition: User cart has known items with prices and quantities
TestData: Cart sum is known; client sends total_amount equal to that sum
ExpectedResult: Persisted order.total_amount MUST equal the server-computed sum of the user's cart line items (price*quantity) for user A, proving the server recalculates and does not trust the client value
HumanReview: STUDENT-ADDED (case AI missed). AI's API2-002/003 said the total 'equals server cart total' abstractly but never pinned the computation (sum of line items) or a read-back assertion. Reason AI missed: oracle too abstract / prompt quality - the AI assumed server recompute without defining how the server total is derived.

Title: Double-submit of the same populated-cart checkout creates exactly one order
TestData: Send the identical checkout request twice back-to-back
ExpectedResult: Exactly ONE order is created for the two identical requests (idempotent/deduplicated); the second request must not duplicate the order
HumanReview: STUDENT-ADDED (case AI missed). AI's API2-021 modelled 'repeat after cart cleared' but not true double-submit idempotency of the same request. BUG (verified): implementation creates a separate order for each request. Reason AI missed: model limitation - the AI did not model duplicate-submission idempotency.

Title: Read-back verifies created order state and ownership via GET /api/orders/my-orders
ExpectedResult: The created order appears in the user's my-orders with status='pending' and user_id = the authenticated user; total matches the server-computed amount
HumanReview: STUDENT-ADDED (case AI missed). AI asserted 'pending' only as text in the oracle but never included a read-back step to verify the persisted status and ownership. Reason AI missed: state-transition modeling was incomplete - the AI did not add the verification action (GET my-orders) to confirm the created state.

Title: SQL injection / string injection in the numeric total_amount field
TestData: total_amount="' OR '1'='1" or a non-numeric string
ExpectedResult: No query manipulation, no type-confusion, no order persisted with a hostile/non-numeric total; controlled 4xx or server total used
HumanReview: STUDENT-ADDED (case AI missed). AI tested injection only on the address string field (API2-027) and never on the numeric total_amount field. BUG (verified): a string total is accepted and stored. Reason AI missed: API characteristic - the numeric field was overlooked as an injection/type surface.

Title: Cross-user cart isolation: user A checkout must not read or consume user B's cart
Precondition: Two users with separate populated carts
TestData: User A token; total_amount reflects A's own cart
ExpectedResult: A's order total must reflect only A's cart; user B's cart must remain untouched (no cross-user cart read or mutation)
HumanReview: STUDENT-ADDED (case AI missed). AI tested ownership via body-field injection (API2-013/025) but never tested actual cross-user CART content isolation. Reason AI missed: model limitation - the AI did not model cart-content isolation between two real users.

Title: Overlong shipping_address length boundary
ExpectedResult: The system bounds or rejects the overlong address (controlled 4xx) rather than persisting unbounded data; no crash or excessive response
HumanReview: STUDENT-ADDED (case AI missed). AI covered empty/whitespace/non-string addresses but no BVA upper-length bound. BUG (verified): there is no length validation, so an overlong address is stored verbatim. Reason AI missed: prompt quality - the boundary-value set was incomplete (no maximum-length case).
